title: hypericum erectum var. parviflorum
intro: Hypericum erectum var. parviflorum, commonly known as low-growing St. John's Wort, is a perennial herbaceous plant in the family Hypericaceae. This plant is used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of mild to moderate depression. The therapeutic actions of Hypericum erectum var. parviflorum include sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as hyperforin and hypericin. The health benefits of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate neurotransmitter levels, reduce anxiety, and promote relaxation.
